correctness.rationale: A direct Fubini section formula over the p-1 ordinary first-part potentials and q second-part potentials reduces the volume to F_{r,k}(L,h). Its deficit is an exact binomial sum in (L-h+1)_+. A range-density identity valid also for p=2 yields closed beta moments, the stated finite-sum formula, endpoint volumes, strictly increasing deletion increments, and a positive leading power p+q-k at h=3. Independent Ehrhart finite differences exactly reproduced eight nontrivial rational or integer cases. Finite tests are not used as a proof of the all-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: Simultaneous relaxation of a star of metric inequalities is a natural structured perturbation of complete bipartite Lipschitz-free Banach geometry. The theorem gives an exact all-size, all-real-parameter volume spline and rigorously identifies a new nonadditive deletion interaction and sharp loss of smoothness from exponent p+q-1 for one edge to p+q-k for k edges. This is a motivated structural invariant, not a re-enumerated known table or arbitrary numerical slice.
